en.headline: Seven vehicles collide on Tuen Mun Road near Hong King Garden
en.dek: Police were called at 7.21am to the Kowloon-bound carriageway; three drivers were sent to hospital and the Transport Department closed some lanes.
body: Seven vehicles collided on Tuen Mun Road towards Kowloon near Hong King Garden on Friday morning, leaving three drivers injured and slowing the rush-hour run into the urban area.
Police said they received the report at 7.21am. The pile-up involved private cars and a taxi. Three drivers reported injuries and were taken to hospital. Officers were investigating the cause.

The Transport Department said some traffic lanes on the Kowloon-bound carriageway near Hong King Garden had been closed because of the crash, leaving drivers to use the remaining lanes. It described traffic at the scene as heavy and asked motorists to watch conditions on the approach.

zh.headline: 屯門公路近豪景花園7車相撞 3司機送院
zh.dek: 警方早上7時21分接報往九龍方向近豪景花園發生連環相撞，運輸署封閉部分行車線，上址交通繁忙。
body: 屯門公路今早往九龍方向近豪景花園發生7車相撞，3名司機報稱受傷送院，出九龍方向交通受阻。
警方表示，早上7時21分接報，意外涉及私家車及的士。3名司機報稱受傷，由救護車送院治理。警方正調查意外原因。
運輸署表示，受交通意外影響，屯門公路往九龍方向近豪景花園部分行車線已經封閉，駕駛人士只可使用餘下行車線。署方指上址交通繁忙，呼籲途經該路段的司機留意現場情況。
